title: Top Holiday Gifts for Plumbers
summary: Looking for plumber gifts this holiday season? From a thermal imaging camera and pipe wrench to a heated vest and tool belt, find gift ideas your team will use.
body_markdown:
Nothing tests a kitchen sink like a holiday dinner for 20, and nobody knows that better than your plumbers. Between backed-up disposals, overworked water heaters, and the frozen-pipe calls that spike the second temperatures drop, they spend the season crawling under sinks and squeezing into crawl spaces so everyone else's holiday runs smoothly.


Skip the same old gift card this holiday season. We rounded up gift ideas for plumbers they’ll actually use, from a thermal camera that spots hidden leaks to the gear that keeps them warm, comfortable, and organized on every call.

## Tool Bag


Give the gift of organization with the[Klein Tools Tradesman Pro Wide-Open Tool Bag](https://www.amazon.com/Klein-Tools-Tradesman-Wide-Open-55469/dp/B073Z5VXLV) . This tool organizer is built from rugged 1680 ballistic weave with a molded bottom and 42 pockets, plus a detachable shoulder strap for hauling wrenches, fittings, screwdrivers, and other hand tools from the truck to the job. Its wide-open design means less digging around for that one fitting at the bottom of the bag.


## Thermal Imaging Camera


This is where AI-style diagnostics meet the plumbing van. The[FLIR Edge Pro Wireless Thermal Imaging Camera](https://www.amazon.com/Flir-Edge-Pro-Smartphones-Compatible/dp/B0BLJD6Q5G) pairs wirelessly with a smartphone and streams a live thermal image to the FLIR app, helping plumbers spot hidden leaks and moisture behind walls or under floors without opening things up first. It's a smart way to diagnose a problem before ever picking up a wrench.


## Heated Vest


Keep them warm on cold basement and crawl-space calls with the[Carhartt Smart Heated Vest](https://www.carhartt.com/product/105890/smart-heated-vest) . It has adjustable heat zones and a rechargeable battery, so they can dial in warmth without adding bulk under a jacket or coveralls.


## Rechargeable Headlamp


Light up water heater closets and cabinets with the[NEBO Transcend Rechargeable Headlamp](https://www.amazon.com/NEBO-Transcend-1000-Lumen-Headlamp-Flashlight/dp/B084HM37CR) . It puts out up to 1,000 lumens across five light modes and includes a detachable magnetic work light, so they can free up both hands under a sink.


## Knee Pads


Give their knees a break after years of kneeling on tile, concrete, and crawl-space plywood.[ToughBuilt Gel-Fit Knee Pads](https://www.amazon.com/ToughBuilt-GelFit-Professional-Knee-Pads/dp/B0140V9C3A) combine gel cushioning with a hard outer shell and adjustable straps that stay put through a full day of service calls.


>>Need more tool ideas? Check out our[32 Best Plumbing Tools](https://www.servicetitan.com/blog/best-plumbing-tools) blog.


## Pipe Wrench


You can't go wrong with a quality wrench. The[RIDGID 24" Heavy-Duty Straight Pipe Wrench](https://www.amazon.com/31030-Heavy-Duty-Straight-24-inch-Plumbing/dp/B0000224JA) features self-cleaning threads and hook jaws built to grip pipe after pipe without slipping — the kind of tool a plumber holds onto for an entire career, not just a season.


## Rechargeable Flashlight


For jobs that need serious brightness, the[Fenix WT26RM Rechargeable Work Light](https://fenix-store.com/products/fenix-wt26rm-rechargeable-work-light-2500-lumens) puts out up to 2,500 lumens across separate spot, flood, and red light modes. A 360-degree rotating magnetic mount with a hook lets this magnetic flashlight stick to a furnace or hang from a pipe, freeing up both hands for the actual repair.


## Tool Belt


Keep the tools they reach for most within arm's reach with a sturdy leather rig like the[Occidental Leather Pro Tool Belt](https://www.amazon.com/Occidental-Leather-5080-XL-Package/dp/B00I3NYGDI) . Its quick-release buckle and padded back support make it comfortable to wear through a full day of service calls — without lugging around a toolbox —and the leather only gets better with age.


## Multi-Tool


A quality multi-tool earns its spot on a plumber's belt fast. The[Leatherman Surge](https://www.amazon.com/LEATHERMAN-Multitool-Replaceable-Spring-Action-Stainless/dp/B0014VVVCK) packs 21 tools into one stainless-steel body, including full-size pliers, wire cutters, and a saw, so they can handle most small jobs without walking back to the truck.


## Equipment Tracker


Help them stop losing gear between job sites. A[Tile Pro 4-Pack](https://www.amazon.com/Tile-Life360-Pro-Bluetooth-Compatible/dp/B0D634ZR1Y) clips onto tool bags, ladders, or a van keychain and pairs with a smartphone to show its last known location, so nothing gets left behind at the last stop of a long day.


## Wire Stripper


A good stripper is one they'll reach for every single day. The[IDEAL Electrical Stripmaster Wire Stripper](https://www.amazon.com/Ideal-Industries-Stripmaster-Wire-Stripper/dp/B000RFSWF8) is an industry-standard pick, with precision-ground, knife-type blades and a die-cast zinc frame built to strip cleanly without nicking the wire, call after call.


## Insulated Tumbler


This[YETI Rambler Tumbler](https://www.amazon.com/YETI-Rambler-Stainless-Insulated-MagSlider/dp/B073WJMKHN) is built to survive life in a work truck. Vacuum insulation keeps coffee hot or water cold for hours, and the MagSlider lid keeps it from sloshing over paperwork on the dash.


## Funny Plumber Gifts


Sometimes the best gift is the one that gets a laugh. If your plumber has a good sense of humor, these lighthearted picks are worth a look:


-


[BigMouth Inc. The Original Toilet Mug](https://www.amazon.com/BigMouth-Inc-Toilet-Ceramic-Perfect/dp/B002SQG4TU) is a ceramic mug shaped like a toilet bowl — a silly nod to the trade that's sure to get a laugh at the office.


-


[Hot Sox Plumber Socks](https://www.amazon.com/Hot-Sox-Plumber-Socks-Black/dp/B0BCH7B3RH) dress up an everyday crew sock with a plumbing-themed print — a fun stocking stuffer or white elephant pick.


-


A["World's Best Plumber" T-shirt](https://www.amazon.com/Worlds-Best-Plumber-Funny-Plumbing/dp/B07J45V187) gives them a simple, wearable way to earn some bragging rights around the shop.


Pair one of these with a more practical gift, or use it as a low-stakes pick for a gift exchange.


## Stocking Stuffers


Need a last-minute gift? Consider these thoughtful gift options that show your plumbers you appreciate them.


-


A holiday bonus or extra paid time off.


-


Hand warmers for cold weather calls.


-


A compact LED inspection flashlight or pen light.


-


Touchscreen-compatible work gloves.


-


A gift for a Secret Santa or white elephant gift exchange.
